claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows "EOS 5D Mark II" on the front right; Photo 2 shows the Canon label and serial number on the bottom.

claims.claim: It is a full-frame DSLR with a 21.1-megapixel sensor

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or core functions are defective
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a picture, and reviewing it on the LCD.

risks.risk: Shutter count is high or unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu or PC software.
risks.if_unproven: as unknown wear with potential high shutter count

risks.risk: Image sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels
risks.proof: Photo of a plain white wall at a small aperture or video showing sensor condition.

risks.risk: Autofocus, buttons, dials, or screen do not work
risks.proof: Video demonstrating each button, dial, autofocus lock, and screen display.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, or memory card missing or dead
risks.proof: Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card together with the camera, plus a video of the battery charging.
risks.if_unproven: as body only with no working accessories

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, or accessories missing
risks.proof: Photo of the box and paperwork.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible from front, rear, and bottom
risks.proof: Additional photos of the top, sides, lens mount, hot shoe, and ports.

risks.risk: No warranty or grey market import
risks.proof: Warranty card, receipt, or Canon service verification.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, shooting, and reviewing an image.
Screenshot of the shutter count from the menu or software.
Photos of the lens without the cap, front and rear elements.
Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card together.
Photos of the camera top, sides, lens mount, and ports.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II from the photos, so a worst-case price is possible. All claims about shutter count, lens condition, accessories, and repair history are unproven and priced accordingly.
